remarks:
This house sits on just OVER A HALF ACRE LOT in Olean’s highly desirable East End with no neighbors right on top of you! 326 Line Street combines a spacious lot, a well-maintained 3 Bedroom 2 Bath home, and endless potential to create the home you’ve always envisioned. Offering approximately 1,760 square feet of living space, this inviting home provides a functional layout with generous room sizes and timeless character throughout. The main level features a spacious living room that’s ideal for relaxing, entertaining, or gathering with family and friends, along with a formal dining room perfect for holiday meals and everyday dining. The large kitchen offers an abundance of cabinetry and countertop space, giving you plenty of room to cook while providing an excellent opportunity to update and personalize to your own taste over time. A full bathroom and convenient first-floor laundry room add to the home’s everyday functionality. Upstairs, you’ll find three comfortable bedrooms, a second full bathroom, and a walk-up attic offering tremendous storage space. The seller is offering $2,000 credit at closing to assist with replacing the worn carpeting, so you can choose the flooring of your choice. 
Outside is where this property truly shines. The expansive yard provides endless possibilities for gardening, outdoor entertaining, play areas, or simply enjoying the peaceful setting. A partially fenced backyard is perfect for your loved one's safety when you're not looking, while the large storage building is great for lawn equipment, tools, recreational vehicles, hobbies, or workshop space. 
Lovingly maintained over the years, this home offers the perfect balance of move-in comfort and the opportunity to add your own updates to personalize it as well as build equity. If you’ve been searching for space, functionality, and one of Olean’s most sought-after neighborhoods, 326 Line Street is a property you’ll want to experience for yourself.
